title: Do not automatically cap strong winners
statement: The 2R requirement is an entry-quality test, not an unconditional full-position profit cap; strong winners are held until a valid deterioration/exit signal.

evidence.title: How To Start Day Trading in 2026 (full training)
evidence.note: The full training says hitting the initial target does not require selling the whole position and explicitly says not to cap winners.

title: Current exit indicators
statement: Exit evidence includes a persistent large seller, hidden/iceberg seller, a burst of red tape, a dramatic false breakout, slowing buying, a topping tail, or a meaningful red candle.

evidence.title: Growing a $2k Account to $65,662.04 in 30 Days (My Day Trading Strategy)
evidence.note: The August course enumerates these exit indicators and notes that a merely flashing displayed seller is not enough.

title: Hidden-seller absorption
statement: A hidden/iceberg seller is suggested when substantial aggressive buying executes but price fails to advance or displayed ask liquidity repeatedly replenishes.

evidence.title: Level 2 for Day Trading (+$65k in 2hrs After Spotting Hidden Buyers)
evidence.note: The dedicated Level-2 lesson explains hidden liquidity through executed volume versus displayed liquidity and price response.

title: Four-stage momentum cycle
statement: Momentum regimes cycle through cold/no response, a surprise spark, sustained hot momentum, and an exhausted phase with weaker imitation catalysts and sharp reversals before returning cold.

evidence.title: Four (4) Market Types You NEED To Understand 🍏 Small Account Challenge Day 2 and Day 3
evidence.note: The market-cycle lesson explicitly teaches four stages: cold, spark, sustained momentum/hot, and exhausted leading back to cold.

title: Throttle aggression by regime
statement: Reduce size and expectations in cold/choppy conditions and increase permissible aggression only after the market demonstrates sustained momentum.

evidence.title: Four (4) Market Types You NEED To Understand 🍏 Small Account Challenge Day 2 and Day 3
evidence.note: The cycle lesson explicitly describes reducing share size in cold markets and becoming more aggressive as the hot cycle is confirmed.
